target: Sum of the six reported sectors, including allocated international aviation; not a complete national GHG inventory.
interval_note: Indicative range from four historical validation errors at the same horizon; not a calibrated confidence interval.
revision_note: Corrected edition after prior test results were inspected. Same date windows are retained for debugging comparability; this rerun is not a newly untouched final test. No alpha or model choices were tuned to test errors. Sector-history control added to separate input information from representation effects.
protocol: Select lowest validation MAE over 12-month horizons. Evaluate on later rolling origins without reselection. Refit direct horizon-specific Ridge models on all available history. Unit 3 transforms frozen at December 2022; regression scalers fit only within each training window.
